summary: Evaluate model releases, investigate production signals, and document controls. Explore this five-day AI model evaluation training course.
lede: AI model evaluation and monitoring training is for intermediate practitioners who test model behavior and inform release or corrective decisions. Participants learn to set acceptance criteria, assess dataset coverage, compare model versions, analyze failures across subgroups, and investigate production traces and drift. They also create adversarial test records, monitoring thresholds, and evidence-based release or rollback recommendations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for intermediate practitioners who test AI behavior, inspect production evidence, and help technical and business teams decide what to change or release.
prerequisites: Suitable for intermediate practitioners with experience evaluating AI or machine-learning systems, reviewing model outputs, or supporting production monitoring. Familiarity with evaluation datasets and model lifecycle workflows will help. No programming prerequisite is specified; exercises focus on evaluation design, evidence interpretation, and operational recommendations rather than coding implementation.
